vendor/qrcode.min.js is qrcodejs 1.0.0, unmodified (byte-identical to the npm
package qrcodejs@1.0.0 and to the cdnjs copy).
Source: https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs
It bundles "QRCode for JavaScript" by Kazuhiko Arase (http://www.d-project.com/),
also MIT-licensed. "QR Code" is a registered trademark of DENSO WAVE INCORPORATED.
